jobs.title: PolyPath Market Risk Technology Specialist (Java/Python)
jobs.description:
It Starts Here

Santander is a global leader and innovator in the financial services industry and is evolving from a high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization. Our people are at the heart of this journey and together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible. This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.

If you are interested in exploring the possibilities We Want to Talk to You!

The Difference You Make

Santander's Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) business is seeking an experienced PolyPath Market Risk Specialist
with strong technical and business knowledge to support pricing, valuation, and market risk activities within a large banking or capital markets environment.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in PolyPath
, strong hands-on programming skills in Python and Java
, and solid knowledge of fixed income products
, particularly structured products such as Mortgage-Backed Securities, Collateralized Mortgage Obligations, and other securitized fixed income instruments
. Candidate should understand both the business side of market risk and the technical side of supporting large-scale financial systems. They should be comfortable working with traders, risk managers, quants, model teams, developers, and infrastructure teams.

This role requires someone who can work closely with front office, risk, finance, model, and technology teams to support risk models, valuation tools, pricing workflows, and market risk systems.

Key Responsibilities

Support and enhance PolyPath platform capabilities used for pricing, valuation, trading, and market risk workflows.
Partner with business, risk, model, and technology teams to translate complex market risk and fixed income requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Support market risk processes including sensitivities, stress testing, scenario analysis, VaR, pricing, and valuation workflows.
Work with fixed income and structured products, including:
Mortgage-Backed Securities
Collateralized Mortgage Obligations
Asset-backed or securitized products
Other structured fixed income instruments

Develop, enhance, and troubleshoot applications, scripts, and integration components using Python and Java.
Support pricing pipelines, risk data flows, market data integration, and valuation processes within the PolyPath ecosystem.
Analyze system issues, performance bottlenecks, data discrepancies, and production incidents related to PolyPath and downstream risk systems.
Collaborate with front office, risk, finance, infrastructure, and application development teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of risk analytics.
Support migration, modernization, and integration initiatives involving legacy trading or risk systems and PolyPath architecture.
Improve platform stability through automation, monitoring, alerting, and issue resolution processes.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description
UAD Consulting provides business analytics and data-driven consulting services that help organizations transform complex data into clear, actionable insights. The firm’s work spans business analytics, data visualization, digital analytics, performance measurement, statistical modeling, and applied research, supporting clients in understanding performance and identifying opportunities. UAD Consulting combines rigorous analytical methods with a practical understanding of business objectives, economics, and decision-making. Rather than using a one-size-fits-all solution, the team selects methods and tools that fit each organization’s data environment and goals. Its toolkit includes SQL, Python, R, SPSS, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, BigQuery, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and Adobe Analytics.
Role Description
The Junior Data Analyst internship is a remote role focused on supporting data projects across analytics, reporting, and visualization. Day-to-day responsibilities include collecting and cleaning data from various sources, conducting basic exploratory analysis, and preparing datasets for use in dashboards and reports. The intern will assist in building visualizations, documenting methods and workflows, and helping senior analysts translate business questions into measurable metrics. The role also involves supporting digital analytics tracking, validating data quality, and summarizing findings in clear, structured formats for internal stakeholders. This is an internship position with opportunities to learn modern analytics tools and contribute to real client work in a collaborative environment.
Qualifications

Foundational analytical skills in statistics, data exploration, and quantitative problem-solving.
Experience or coursework with data tools such as Excel and at least one of SQL, Python, or R.
Interest in data visualization and familiarity with tools like Tableau or Power BI is beneficial.
Awareness of digital analytics concepts and platforms (e.g., GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics) is a plus.
Strong attention to detail, ability to document work clearly, and commitment to data quality.
Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain findings in an accessible way.
Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage time, and collaborate with a distributed team.
Current enrollment in or recent completion of a program in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, business analytics, or a related field.

Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.

GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.

Job Summary

The Chemical Lab Technician will play a vital role in supporting our operations by conducting tests, analyses, and inspections on materials and components to ensure compliance with industry standards and specifications. This position requires a strong understanding of laboratory practices and procedures, as well as the ability to work effectively within a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Job Responsibilities

Follow laboratory plans, procedures and instructions set forth by Engineering Department. Provide data and information to lab personnel, and other customers, as appropriate.
Deliver technical training and provide guidance to other GKN Laboratory Technicians. Perform testing for chemical and metallurgical sample.
Responsible for ensuring adherence to acceptance test procedures.
Responsible for the execution of any customer and regulatory-delegated inspection processes as authorized by those parties. Responsible for maintaining those delegated authorities once granted.
Experience in using hardness tester, tensile test machine, microscopic evaluation and other related equipment.
Participate in authorities or OEM audit, round robin and correlation testing and other event when necessary
Support continuous improvement of production and inspection processes by implementing Lean initiatives.
Performs other duties, tasks and responsibilities as assigned.

Job Qualifications

2-3 years of experience in a process control or certification laboratory testing environment
Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Material Engineering.
Familiarity with lab testing equipments, customer requirement and general specification e.g ASTM, AMS etc.
Previous delegated product acceptance authority granted by an Aerospace OEM or regulatory authority.
Knowledge in Metallurgical, thermal spray coating and chemical analysis

Compensation Range

The compensation range for this position is between $21.00-$25.50 per hour.

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work.

We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know.

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Development Representative - Life Sciences
new_jobs.description:
Inside Sales Development Representative - Life Sciences

San Francisco - OnSite Permanent / Full Time4/10/2026
Inside Sales Development Representative - Life Sciences
Location: Fremont, California
Work Arrangement: Full-time onsite, Monday through Friday
Compensation: $85,000-$100,000 annual base salary plus commission
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Life Sciences, Genomics and Omics Services

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated Inside Sales Development Representative to support the growth of a life sciences and genomics services organization.
This position is responsible for creating targeted prospect lists, developing new customer relationships, increasing engagement through LinkedIn and other outbound channels, and scheduling qualified client meetings for Account Executives.
The successful candidate will combine strong sales-development skills with a scientific education and a genuine passion for biology. They must be comfortable discussing genomics, molecular biology and life sciences applications with prospective customers.
This is a full-time, onsite position. Candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of Fremont, California.

What You Will Do

Research target markets and build accurate prospect lists across relevant life sciences, biotechnology and research organizations.
Identify prospective customers, decision-makers, scientific stakeholders and other relevant contacts.
Develop LinkedIn connections and maintain consistent, professional engagement with prospective customers.
Conduct daily outbound prospecting through LinkedIn, email, telephone and other approved channels.
Generate interest in the organization's genomics and omics services.
Qualify prospects by developing an initial understanding of their scientific requirements, business priorities and potential applications.
Schedule qualified discovery calls, technical discussions and client meetings for Account Executives.
Manage Account Executive calendars and coordinate meetings with prospective customers.
Provide Account Executives with clear background information, qualification notes and potential customer requirements before scheduled meetings.
Nurture early-stage prospects who are not yet ready for an Account Executive conversation.
Follow up with contacts generated through industry conferences, events, referrals and other marketing activities.
Maintain accurate records of prospecting activities, LinkedIn engagement, conversations, follow-up actions and scheduled meetings in the CRM.
Track activity against weekly and quarterly pipeline-development goals.
Work closely with Account Executives to refine prospecting strategies, target accounts and messaging.
Respond promptly and professionally to prospective customer inquiries.
Perform other sales-development responsibilities as required.

Qualifications

At least one year of experience in inside sales, sales development, technical sales or another customer-facing role.
Demonstrated understanding of the sales-funnel and lead-qualification process.
Experience researching accounts, creating prospect lists and identifying appropriate decision-makers.
Comfortable using LinkedIn for professional networking, prospect engagement and relationship development.
Ability to conduct consistent outbound outreach and confidently initiate conversations with new prospects.
Strong organizational, prioritization and time-management skills.
Ability to manage a high volume of prospecting, follow-up and scheduling activities.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate CRM records.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with scientists, business stakeholders, Account Executives and management.
Strong work ethic, persistence, sense of urgency and desire to achieve sales goals.
Experience working with a CRM system is an asset.
Knowledge of next-generation sequencing methods—particularly DNA sequencing, RNA sequencing and single-cell RNA sequencing—is strongly preferred.
Previous hands-on laboratory experience is strongly preferred.
Education and Scientific Interest
Bachelor's degree or higher in biology, molecular biology, genomics or a closely related scientific discipline.
A genuine passion for biology, scientific research and life sciences innovation.
Ability and interest in learning about genomics, sequencing and omics applications.
Ability to understand prospective customers' scientific needs and communicate those requirements effectively to Account Executives and technical specialists.

Additional Requirements

Must be available to work onsite in Fremont, California, Monday through Friday.
Occasional travel to customer locations and industry conferences may be required.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
Employment sponsorship is not available.
Benefits
Base salary plus commission
401(k) matching
Medical, dental and vision insurance
Flexible spending account
Health savings account
Life insurance
Paid time off
Monday-through-Friday lunch program
